removal_suggestion: This equivalence is intrinsic to the stated equality and cannot be removed by rewording without changing the task. A task-preserving presentation change is therefore unavailable.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: It reduces the equality to selecting an independent set of size k, then searches for one by backtracking.

common_affordance: The equality condition makes every selected shared block have at most one selected endpoint, exactly the independent-set condition.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its meet-in-the-middle implementation terminated with a runtime error before producing a valid result.
It enumerates all k-subsets and recomputes the metrics, causing time-limit failure near n=46.
Although its comment identifies the independent-set reduction, its implementation/output path received wrong answer; the excerpt does not expose the exact implementation mistake.

recommended_edit: Append a mutable requirement that the selected documents must form a maximal independent set: after selection, no unselected document may be added while preserving the equality. The shown examples remain valid, but the survivor's solver does not check maximality and will fail on cases where its first size-k independent set is extendable.
regression_risk: This added condition could make some previously defeated brute-force solvers pass if they are modified to validate maximality, but it does not restore the submitted implementations.
